security.item: Custom CSS escaping: the Custom CSS field is now escaped on output (< is encoded), so a value can no longer close the <style> block and inject a script
Clock settings in the page script: clock labels are now encoded so < and & can't affect the inline script that passes the settings to the clocks

addition.item: File check: the module settings now show whether every installed file matches the released version, and warn when an install or update did not finish (for example a file left at 0 bytes)
